title: Maho Ako Launches ‘Utena Eau de Toilette’ — A Fragrance Inspired by Utena Hiiragi
content: Gushing Over Magical Girls’ production company recently announced “Smells Like Baby Spirit”, an eau de toilette inspired by Utena Hiiragi’s scent! The Utena eau de toilette will debut at Maho Ako pop-up shops in Kinshicho and Namba this sunmer. Afterwards, select online retailers will carry the product.
